faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Send an enquiry with service type, deadline, track count, and what files you have ready. You'll get a clear next step — not an automated contract price.

faqs.question: How should I send stems?
faqs.answer: Export WAV stems at the same sample rate, with processing off unless agreed. Label tracks clearly (kick, bass, vocals, etc.). Include a rough mix reference if you have one.

faqs.question: How many revisions are included?
faqs.answer: Standard mixing includes two revision rounds after the first mix. Mastering includes one revision round. Extra rounds can be quoted if the scope grows.

faqs.question: What turnaround should I expect?
faqs.answer: Turnaround starts when stems or files are received and any questions are answered. Rush deadlines may be possible — mention your date in the enquiry.

faqs.question: When is payment due?
faqs.answer: Payment terms are confirmed in your quote or invoice. Typically a deposit or full payment is agreed before final delivery files are released.
